question: Four words are given, out of which three words are spelt correctly. Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**ACQIUANT**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the word in option 4 is incorrectly spelt.**
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is ACQUAINT.**
 
• The incorrect spelling in option 4 is missing the letter 'N'.
 
 
• The word means to make someone or something familiar with or aware of something.(परिचित)
 
• Example: I need to acquaint myself with the new office policies.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Resistance" means trying to stop something from happening or to stop somebody from doing something; fighting back against somebody/something. (प्रतिरोध)
 
• "Privilege" means a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.(विशेषाधिकार)
 
• "Persistent" means determined to continue doing something even though people say that you are wrong or that you cannot do it.(ज़िद्दी)
